newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures higher in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures higher in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were higher across the board in after-hours trade on Tuesday on bargain-hunting buying, supported by firmer prices in rubber-producing countries, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.9 yen to 1.6 yen per kg higher than the day's close. Newly listed benchmark February was 141.4 yen after closing at 140.5 yen. Volume was 5,361 lots.

During the day, after prices opened easier, firmer overseas market encouraged buying. "If overseas markets continue to firm, the market here may rise further amid improved sentiment," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
